newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Exporters to take positive view on NZ dlr - Peters.
newsitem.headline: Exporters to take positive view on NZ dlr - Peters.

text.p: NZ First Party Leader Winston Peters said on Wednesday that exporters would take a positive view of the recent decline in the New Zealand dollar and in interest rates since Tuesday's coalition announcement.
Peters, who is to become Treasurer in the new coalition, said he would take time to ensure there was no surprise or panic in the market.

"I think the exporters of this country have taken a positive view of things thus far, both in respect of interest rates, which have fallen almost a percent, and the dollar. That's good for New Zealand exporters, good for New Zealand homeowners and business people," Peters said.
"What I would like to do is take time to ensure that there is no strife or panic in the market," he said.
Peters said he expected to be briefed by the Treasury, after which he would be better positioned to comment.
